title: Outstanding Oven Roasted Spanish Beef Fideua
description: A traditional Spanish dish featuring mixed beef cuts and double-rise-bread, perfect for a satisfying meal. This nut-free-friendly recipe is great for a hangover cure.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the beef pieces with olive oil, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the beef mixture in a single layer on a large baking sheet.
Roast the beef in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.
While the beef is roasting, toast the double-rise-bread cubes by spreading them on a baking sheet and baking for 10 minutes.
After the beef has roasted for 30 minutes, add the toasted bread cubes and chicken broth to the baking sheet with the beef.
Return the baking sheet to the oven and continue roasting for an additional 20 minutes, or until the bread is crispy and the beef is tender.
Remove the baking sheet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the Outstanding Oven Roasted Spanish Beef Fideua hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
